biography: My career with Rosendin started in 2000 as an Assistant Project Manager moving to Project Manager, Project Executive, and Director leading the organization through complex power and technology projects. In 2008, I established Rosendin’s Mission Critical Group and, in 2011, founded Rosendin’s sister company, Modular Power Solutions. In my role as COO, I lead high-performance teams and set the direction for continuous operational innovation overseeing and supporting our operating units in Hawaii, California, and the Pacific Northwest.
